title: Approval of Agreement Nos. 47058A, 47058B, 47058C, 47058D, 47058E,
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Administrative Officer
  Approval of Agreement Nos. 47058A, 47058B, 47058C, 47058D, 47058E,
  and 47058F for Armed and Unarmed Contract Security Services and
  Employee Protection Agents with Inter-Con Security Systems, Inc.; Absolute
  Security Intl Corp dba Absolute International Security; The Gadite Group,
  Inc.; Universal Protection Service LP dba Allied Universal Security Services;
  J Blair Group, Inc.; and American Guard Services, Inc. The Agreements are
  for a term of three years plus an optional two years, exercisable in one-year
  increments for a cumulative amount not to exceed $45,000,000 and will
  expire five years after execution, if all option years are exercised.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section
  15060(c)(3).
